newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down on low turnover.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down on low turnover.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended down on Sunday on low turnover due to the Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) office-bearers election, dealers said.

KSE's 100-share index ended 21.97 points or 1.55 percent down at 1,391.62, with 188 losers and 38 gainers. Turnover fell to a provisional 11 million from Thursday's 32 million. The market was closed on the Friday and Saturday weekend.

Low buying interest amid the elections hammered the index, which was likely to fall further on Monday's settlement day, one dealer of Fortune Securities said. HUBCO fell 0.55 of a rupee to 32.95 and PTCL 0.35 to 26.70.
